selection_rules.representative_no_change_or_stall: prefer the lexicographically first matched problem where both remain incorrect; otherwise choose unchanged correctness with the smallest absolute valid speedup delta, then workspace
selection_rules.speedup_improvement: largest positive candidate-minus-baseline valid speedup delta; workspace name breaks ties
selection_rules.speedup_regression: most negative candidate-minus-baseline valid speedup delta; workspace name breaks ties
selection_rules.valid_speedup: finite positive best speedup with best_correct=true and best_is_hack=false; a delta exists only when both runs have valid speedups
